subject: Renewal kickoff: timeline, capacity options, and QBR booking
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@aurigacorp.com>, procurement@aurigacorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff: timeline, capacity options, and QBR booking

Hi Ellie / Aurigacorp team —

Thanks for the strong usage this past year. Per our renewal window, I wanted to kick off a short runway to align on term options, any capacity increases you expect for Q3, and a calendar slot for the renewal QBR. Proposed agenda below and a short mutual action plan (attached) to capture owners and dates.

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 1 (this week): Align scope — term length, capacity uplift targets, any feature needs (dedicated pools, private deployment).
- Week 2: Pricing and contract terms; internal legal/ procurement reviews.
- Week 3: QBR readout and sign (can be earlier if ready).

Capacity/upsell items we commonly see for customers like you:
- Dedicated capacity pool (predictable throughput) — good if you have >20% token growth or stricter SLOs.
- Burst credits add-on for seasonal peak traffic.
- Longer term / commited monthly commit for improved unit pricing.

Quick asks from our side:
1) Can you share expected % increase in peak token throughput for the next 12 months? (ballpark is fine)
2) Who from your security/procurement/legal teams should be looped into the next call?
3) Two preferred 60–90 minute windows for a QBR in the week of Feb 22 — we have an exec seat available Feb 24 in the afternoon if that helps.

Attachments: Aurigacorp_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — owners & milestone rows).

I’ll coordinate internal readiness (pricing options and SRE staffing notes) once I get your availability.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 12:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: timeline, capacity options, and QBR booking

Internal note —

Quick bullets to prep:
- Pricing options to bring: 12-month vs 24-month term, with committed capacity tiers (Baseline, Baseline+25%, Baseline+50%). Include SKU-level unit pricing and sample monthly invoice math.
- If Auriga wants dedicated pools, we need to confirm expected steady-state throughput and 95th percentile latency SLO target (we should offer a standard SLA + an accelerated option).
- Marissa: I’ll draft a one-pager comparing burst credits vs staircase commit. Laura: can you pull last 6 months token hist and 95th pct?

Also noting procurement cadence: they typically take 7–10 business days once procurement/legal are looped; factor into timeline.

I’ll stand by for dates — if Jonas is proposing Feb 24 afternoon, block a pre-call 30 minutes before with SRE and pricing to align.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@aurigacorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurigacorp.com, legal@aurigacorp.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: timeline, capacity options, and QBR booking

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful.

A few answers and requests:
- Ballpark growth: expect ~30% token volume increase across next 12 months, with two traffic peaks tied to product launches in May and October.
- Please loop in our security engineer (Samir Khan — samir.khan@aurigacorp.com) for any SOC/audit questions; procurement and legal on cc.
- Feb 24 afternoon works for a QBR — can we do Feb 24 at 2:30pm PT? That gives procurement a chance to join.

On capacity: we are leaning toward a Baseline+25% commit and keeping burst credits for launches. Would like to see the pricing delta between 12 and 24 month terms before we make a call.

Attached: none from our side.

Thanks,
Ellie Park
Head of Product Operations, Aurigacorp
ellie.park@aurigacorp.com

Appreciate the quick reply, Ellie — Feb 24 at 2:30pm PT is confirmed on our side. I sent a calendar invite and a placeholder QBR agenda (link below).

Next immediate steps:
- Marissa/Laura: finalize 12 vs 24 month SKUs + Baseline/Baseline+25%/Baseline+50% pricing. Aim to circulate by EOD Wed (Feb 17).
- Marissa: prepare a short SRE note on expected latency SLOs for dedicated pools and incremental staffing cost.
- Jonas: I’ll open the preliminary DocuSign for the Baseline+25% 12-month option for Auriga to review; won’t sign without internal sign-off. Link will be shared in the follow-up.
- Ellie/Samir/Procurement: please confirm if any additional compliance evidence (SOC 2 Type II report, data residency addenda) needed ahead of the QBR so we can prep artifacts.

Attachments added: renewal_pricing_options_v2.pdf (pricing sketches).

Links: https://hubspot.example/deal/HUB-987654, DocuSign (prelim): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?txn=abc123, Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=QBR-AURIGA-20270224

See you on the 24th.
